title: The project showcase got easier to browse
summary:
A community-facing day: better project discovery, two new showcase entries, and a refreshed Unity integration.

A featured tab now gives standout community projects their own shelf, while the showcase added CalcuBite AI and a Node.js client library. More things people built with Pollinations, arranged with slightly less archaeological effort.

The Unity JavaScript integration was refreshed, keeping the path from game project to generative API a little more current.
